requirements: Run ./gradlew :solr:core:test --tests org.apache.solr.cloud.SolrZkServerTlsTest -Dtests.seed=5329ABCD; capture fresh XML, counts, log and return code.

Run ./gradlew :solr:packaging:integrationTests --tests test_secure_example.bats and retain fresh BATS output and XML. Verify the new existing-port/unification integration case actually executes, including password-path failure, TLS success, plaintext rejection and file modes.
Run ./gradlew tidy; require no source changes. If formatting alters files, stop and return the diff for a new exact-head gate.
Run ./gradlew check -x test; retain log and verify the earlier SolrZkServer validateLogCalls failure is resolved.

Fail-before: apply only the updated test class to preceding fork head 7dedae124c252574caaff93cf4bcf2bc1d240fc9, run testAutomaticTlsSuppressesExistingPlaintextPort with the same seed, and record the expected port-unification assertion failure; setup or compilation failures do not count.
Independently assess password-file security at creation under umask 022 and error handling without exposing passwords; post-start file mode alone does not prove the creation race is absent.
Investigate failures; report exact commands, exit codes, counts, and fresh evidence in the named receipt.
unresolved: Persisted options and server configuration do not reconcile TLS rotation or later external ZooKeeper connections. Do not offer the patch publicly on this gate alone.
